dare.label: DARE
dare.description: Complete the dare or face elimination.

challenges.text: What's the most embarrassing thing you've done in public?
What's a secret you've never told your closest friend?
Have you ever blamed someone else for something you did? What happened?
What's the worst lie you've ever told?
What's your most embarrassing memory from school?
Have you ever done something just to impress someone? Did it work?
What's a talent you have that nobody knows about?
What's the most ridiculous thing you've ever cried about?
If you had to pick one person in this room to swap lives with, who would it be and why?
What's the pettiest thing you've ever done to get back at someone?
What's a habit you have that you'd be embarrassed if people found out about?
Who in this room would you trust least in a survival situation?
What's the biggest mistake you've made and never admitted to anyone?
Have you ever pretended to be sick to get out of something? What was it?
What's the strangest thing you've ever searched on Google?
Do your best impression of someone in this room. They have to guess who it is.
Sing the chorus of the last song you listened to: full volume, no skipping.
Let someone in the room style your hair however they want for the rest of the round.
Text someone you haven't spoken to in over a year, right now, and say 'I miss you'.
Speak in an accent chosen by the host for the next 3 minutes.
Call a family member and convince them you've joined a band.
Do 20 jumping jacks while narrating what you're doing in a sports commentary voice.
Let the room write a status on your social media of their choosing. It must stay up for 10 minutes.
Hold a plank position for 30 seconds while everyone counts down.
Recreate the most iconic photo you've taken. Do your best to get it exactly right.
Eat a snack chosen by the group. No complaints, no negotiations.
Let the host read your most recent 5 text messages out loud.
Stand up and do your best catwalk across the room. Do it twice.
Freestyle rap for 30 seconds using the words: 'dare', 'tournament', and 'champion'.
Say something genuinely nice about every person watching: one sentence each.
